Nate (Docs): quick heads-up on PR #4012 - three small but important issues in the snippet bundle (py/ts/go). Wanted to coordinate fixes before we merge.
Clara (SDK): what did you find?
Nate (Docs): 1) Python streaming snippet iterates but never shows cleanup; can leave background tasks/sockets open. 2) TS retry example lacks maxDelay/attempts so users can end up waiting minutes. 3) Go pagination loop doesn't guard against empty cursor and can re-request first page on some backends.
Ibrahim: agree. Proposed minimal fixes so copy-paste users are safe.
Nate (Docs): Python patch (preferred pattern + fallback):
```py
import asyncio

async def run():
    async with client.stream(prompt) as s:
        async for chunk in s:
            print(chunk)

asyncio.run(run())
# fallback for older SDKs: await client.close() after iterating to ensure cleanup
```
Clara (SDK): add a one-line comment explaining why the context manager matters.
Nate (Docs): done. TS suggestion (conservative defaults):
```ts
const retryCfg = { base: 200, factor: 2, maxDelay: 4000, attempts: 6, jitter: true };
await sdk.call({ prompt }, { retry: retryCfg });
// abort immediately on 4xx (non-retriable)
```
Rae (QA): Add note that these are conservative defaults — teams should tune for latency vs success.
Nate (Docs): Go fix: stop when NextCursor()=="" to avoid looping:
```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for {
  if !resp.HasMore() { break }
  next := resp.NextCursor()
  if next == "" { break } // backend sent empty cursor; stop to avoid repeated pages
  resp, _ = client.List(ctx, next)
}
```
Rae (QA): please include a tiny examples_test.go case that returns an empty cursor to assert the loop exits. Saves future copy-paste bugs.
Clara (SDK): will add tests and a short changelog line 'docs: safer streaming/retry/pagination examples'.
